summary: Backend auth/cookie, VAST validation, worker artifacts, and authenticated UI flows tested.

critical.issue: Dashboard stats are readable without authentication (HTTP 200); /api/links and /api/settings also appear unprotected by route dependencies and must be checked/fixed.

action_items: Require valid session auth for dashboard data and all mutating/admin APIs; re-run authorization regression tests.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True; use explicit configured origins for session-cookie security.
Admin passwords are stored and compared as plaintext, despite the requested auth hardening expectations; migrate to bcrypt hashes and preserve login compatibility.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; existing preview data was retained. Temporary CDN/VAST test values were reverted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login and cookies pass with admin/admin123. Authenticated dashboard, output quality switching, CDN settings save, VAST settings save, and missing-slug player state pass. Authorization regression currently fails because /api/stats returns 200 unauthenticated; expand checks to links/settings and CRUD after fix.
rca of the issue: The backend endpoint functions (including stats, links, settings, and likely other admin operations) have no Depends-based session validation. Auth exists only as a separate login/session endpoint, so direct public requests bypass it. Add a shared dependency that validates session_token/refresh behavior and apply it to admin APIs; retain public player/stream routes as intended.
